BKK.name: Suvarnabhumi Airport
intro: If you have just arrived at Suvarnabhumi, clear immigration and collect your bags before heading into Bangkok. If you are departing, check in and pass through departure immigration before continuing to your concourse. The indoor maps separate the main terminal from concourses A–B–C, D and E–F–G.

A Door is an entrance or exit from the terminal building; a Gate is where you board your aircraft. Door 4 and boarding gate D4, for example, are different places. When looking for a smoking room or convenience store, check both the floor and whether it is before or after departure immigration.
facts: Main terminal · concourses A–G · SAT-1 satellite terminal

steps.title: Leaving the airport after arrival
items: Clear immigration, collect your checked bags and continue into the public arrivals hall. If a bag is missing or damaged, report it to your airline’s baggage desk before leaving the controlled arrivals area.
For a limousine, visit an AOT Limousine counter in the domestic or international arrivals area on Level 2 of the main terminal. For a pre-booked rental car, go to Door 7 on the same level.
For the train, follow the Airport Rail Link signs down to Level B1. The Bangkok transport guide explains which station to use and how to change trains.

steps.title: Departure check-in and international connections
items: Find your flight number and operating airline on the departure screens before going to a check-in counter. The airline-counter page separates counter locations and opening hours by airline.

For an international connection, follow the transfer route through security on the east side of Level 3 and continue to the Level 3 boarding area. Follow the Transfer signs and the gate shown on your boarding pass.
Facilities outside the building before departure immigration are separate from those in the departures area. Do not leave the transfer route simply to reach a public-area smoking room.

sections.title: Designated smoking areas
body: The airport’s older official page lists four designated outdoor smoking areas on Level 1: in front of the airport police station, near entrance 10 in front of Magic Food Court, and at parking buildings Zone 2 and Zone 3.

sections.title: Convenience stores, restaurants and ATMs
body: In the main terminal, 7-Eleven is listed at S53 on Level 4, S43 on Level 3 and S78 on Level B1. Lawson is at S56 on Level 4 and S2 on Level 2.
Level 3 has S&P Thai Restaurant & Bakery (F16), Burger King (F12) and KFC (F10).
The KBank ATM in the main terminal is at E20 on Level 3.

sections.title: Finding medical assistance
body: A Medical Clinic is in the public area on Level 1 of the main terminal.
Samitivej medical services are in the public area by Door 3 on Level 3 of the main terminal, and in the transfer area by Gate 117 on Level 3 of SAT-1.
The medical-service information number is 02 132 7777.

faq.q: Where is the KBank ATM at Suvarnabhumi?
faq.a: The main-terminal KBank ATM is marked E20 on the Level 3 map. Use the floor map and facility search together to locate it.

smoking.title: Outside Doors 1 and 10 on Levels 2 and 4
body: After entering the public arrivals hall, look outside Doors 1 and 10 at either end of Level 2. Before departure formalities, use the corresponding doors on Level 4. Door means a building entrance, not boarding gates such as D1 or D10.

The June 2025 opening announcement described four outdoor smoking rooms with air conditioning and air filtration. Once you have passed departure immigration, these public-area rooms are not directly accessible; use the separate airside guidance.

smoking.title: After departure immigration: near the toilets beside Burger King in Concourse D
smoking.status: Visitor reports from August–September 2026 · operation may change
body: After security and departure immigration, look near the toilets beside Burger King in the Concourse D area leading towards E, F and G. Visitor photographs and reports from August–September 2026 show a Smoking Room sign and room here. There is also a Burger King in Concourse F, so check that you are in D.

The map pin identifies Burger King F67 on Level 4 of Concourse D. It does not mark the smoking-room entrance. From the restaurant, follow Smoking Room signs or ask staff. Looking only for a reference to Concourse C could take you to the wrong place.

smoking.title: Miracle Business Class Lounge in Concourse D
smoking.status: Lounge location recorded · smoking-space information conflicts
body: The Miracle Business Class Lounge is on Level 3 of Concourse D, opposite D5. On the map, look for Miracle Lounge L16. A reference to the area near D4 does not identify the floor or distinguish this lounge from the neighbouring first-class lounge.

Visitor reports from 2026 describe a separate smoking space, but Priority Pass lists the lounge as non-smoking. If that space is your reason for visiting, ask whether it is currently open before paying for entry. Do not apply the same smoking conditions to every Miracle lounge.

smoking.title: The older designated outdoor areas on Level 1
smoking.status: Listed on the airport’s official website
body: The airport’s older official information lists four outdoor areas on Level 1: in front of the airport police station, by entrance 10 in front of Magic Food Court, and at parking buildings Zone 2 and Zone 3. Keep these separate from the Level 2/4 rooms and the post-immigration visitor reports above.

pins.label: Concourse D Burger King F67
pins.detail: Landmark for finding the smoking room; this is not the smoking-room entrance.

pins.label: Miracle Lounge L16
pins.detail: Lounge location; ask whether its separate smoking space is open before entering.

DMK.name: Don Mueang Airport
intro: At Don Mueang, Terminal 1 handles international flights and Terminal 2 handles domestic flights. Use Terminal 1 for an international departure. If you are connecting to a flight within Thailand, consult the Terminal 2 map and departure information.

Choose the terminal and floor first to find shops, banks and airport facilities. A staffed bank branch and an ATM are different facilities even when the same bank name appears, so check both the facility type and its location.
facts: 24 hours · individual businesses have their own opening hours

steps.title: Confirm your arrival terminal and onward journey
items: Choose Terminal 1 on the map for an international arrival, or Terminal 2 for a domestic arrival.
For an onward flight, check the terminal and operating airline on your booking or boarding pass first. Ask the airline whether you must collect and recheck your bags.
Before moving from an international arrival to a domestic departure, ask transfer staff which immigration, baggage and terminal-transfer steps your journey requires.

steps.title: From check-in to the boarding gate
items: Use an airline counter, self-service check-in/bag drop or online check-in only where your booked airline and flight support it.
International passengers must pass through departure immigration. Follow your airline’s size and weight limits for cabin bags.
The airport recommends being at the boarding gate at least 45 minutes before scheduled departure. Check-in closes according to your airline’s separate rules.

sections.title: S&P restaurant
body: The S&P restaurant at Don Mueang is on Level 3 of Terminal 1.

sections.title: Banks and ATMs
body: Bangkok Bank is on Level 1 of Terminal 1; KBank is on Level 4 in the domestic departures area of Terminal 2.
SCB ATMs are on Levels 1 and 3 of Terminal 2; a Krungsri ATM is on Level 3 of Terminal 1.
A Krungthai ATM is on Level 3 in the Terminal 2 departures area, and a Government Savings Bank ATM is also on Level 3 of Terminal 2.

faq.q: Where is S&P at Don Mueang?
faq.a: It is on Level 3 of international Terminal 1. Do not confuse it with domestic Terminal 2.

faq.q: Where are the banks and ATMs at Don Mueang?
faq.a: Bangkok Bank is on Level 1 of Terminal 1 and KBank is on Level 4 of domestic Terminal 2. SCB ATMs are on Levels 1 and 3 of Terminal 2. A bank branch and an ATM provide different services.

faq.q: When should I be at my boarding gate?
faq.a: The airport recommends arriving at the gate at least 45 minutes before scheduled departure. This is separate from your airline’s check-in deadline; allow time for check-in and departure immigration.

smoking.title: Outside Door 8, Terminal 1, Level 3
smoking.status: Visitor guidance and photographs from September 2026
body: Recent visitor guidance and photographs describe an outdoor smoking area outside Door 8 on Level 3 of international Terminal 1, towards the connection with Terminal 2. It is used before departure immigration and security.
From outside Door 8 on Level 3 of Terminal 1, follow Smoking Area signs. This public-area outdoor facility is separate from indoor lounges and the area around international boarding gates.

smoking.title: Outside Door 10, Terminal 2, Level 1
body: Visitor guidance describes a container-style smoking area across the small road outside Door 10 on Level 1 of domestic Terminal 2. Building Door 10 is different from aircraft boarding Gate 10.
You cannot go directly there from the international post-immigration area. If the on-site arrangement has changed, ask airport information staff for the designated area currently in use.

HKT.name: Phuket Airport
intro: Phuket has separate international and domestic terminals. For an international arrival or departure, start with the international-terminal map. For flights within Thailand, including Bangkok, use the domestic-terminal map.

The international arrivals hall is on Level 1, while international self-check-in kiosks are in the Level 3 departures hall. Read the location of essential facilities such as medical rooms and smoking areas, then open the corresponding terminal and floor map.
facts: Belts 1–5 · confirm your flight’s assignment on the screens

steps.title: Arriving on an international flight
items: After entry formalities, find your flight number and assigned baggage belt on the screens in the Level 1 international arrivals hall. International arrivals use belts 1–5.
If a checked bag is missing or damaged, speak to your airline’s baggage desk before leaving the arrivals area.

If you need medical help, the clinic is in the public area by Entrance 7 on Level 1 of the international terminal. The medical information below distinguishes it from the domestic first-aid room and its opening hours.

steps.title: Departing or connecting to a domestic flight
items: International self-check-in kiosks are in the Level 3 international departures hall. Their presence does not mean every airline or flight can use them.
Check your operating airline’s counter and bag-drop arrangements. The airline section records locations and service hours where available.

For a domestic connection, check the terminal on your boarding pass and ask whether your bags must be collected and rechecked. Do not mistake an international-terminal clinic or facility for one in the domestic terminal.

sections.title: ATM in the domestic terminal
body: A KBank ATM is in the Level 2 departures area of the domestic terminal. Make sure you are looking in the domestic, not international, terminal.

sections.title: Medical clinic and first aid
body: The Phuket Airport medical clinic is in the public area by Entrance 7 on Level 1 of the international terminal and operates 24 hours a day.
The Level 1 first-aid room in the domestic terminal operates Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00.

faq.q: Where is the KBank ATM at Phuket Airport?
faq.a: It is in the Level 2 departures area of the domestic terminal. Select that terminal and floor in the facility search to view it with the map.

faq.q: Is the international-terminal medical clinic open at night?
faq.a: The public-area clinic by Entrance 7 on Level 1 of the international terminal operates 24 hours. The domestic Level 1 first-aid room instead operates Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00.

faq.q: What does the red smoking-area pin mark?
faq.a: It marks Smoking Area G9 in the domestic-terminal Level 1 directory. It is not an international-terminal boarding gate called G9. Follow the day’s signs for opening and permitted access routes.

smoking.title: Smoking Area G9, domestic terminal, Level 1
smoking.status: Recorded in the official map’s facility directory
body: The domestic-terminal Level 1 map labels its smoking area G9. Use the button below to open the relevant floor and red location pin.

Do not look for the same G9 in the international terminal or assume it is directly accessible after departure immigration. The map records a location; follow current on-site signs for opening and permitted access.

smoking.title: Outdoor smoking area before international departure
smoking.access: Public area · outside the international building
smoking.status: Airline guidance for designated outdoor areas · visitor guidance for the door
body: The airline’s official airport guidance directs smokers to designated areas outside the terminal. Recent visitor guidance places one outside Door 1 on Level 3 of the international terminal. Before departure formalities, follow the on-site Smoking Area signs.

This is a different place from G9 on domestic Level 1. At the international terminal, follow signs and staff directions outside Door 1 on Level 3. The map does not include a pin for this smoking-room entrance.

pins.label: Smoking Area G9
pins.detail: Location of Smoking Area G9 in the official map directory

CNX.name: Chiang Mai Airport
intro: At Chiang Mai Airport, check the Domestic and International signs before moving between facilities. If you order a car after arrival, make sure the pickup point shown in your app matches the designated place where you will meet it.

Use the map to find shops, medical rooms and prayer rooms. For the city, read the shuttle guidance for Door 12 of the international terminal or visit the Grab service centre on domestic Level 1. Self-check-in and self-service bag drop support different airlines.
facts: Domestic terminal, Level 1 public area · 24 hours

steps.title: Leaving the airport for the city
items: Collect your bags in your flight’s terminal and continue to the public arrivals area. For essentials, use the Mini Market in the domestic Level 1 arrivals area.
Order Grab through the app and board at the designated pickup point. If you cannot locate it, visit the Grab service centre in the public area on Level 1 of the domestic terminal.
Airport shuttles leave from Door 12 of the international terminal. Compare the A1, A2 and A3 routes and fares below with the location of your accommodation.

steps.title: Checking in and dropping off bags
items: Self-check-in kiosks and self-service bag-drop machines do different jobs. Check that your airline supports each service before using it.

Machines are listed around airline counters and cafés in the domestic terminal, and near gates 8–9 in the international terminal. The departure information below gives their recorded locations and supported airlines.
After dropping off your bags, recheck your gate on the day’s screens and boarding pass, then arrive at the boarding time given by your airline.

sections.title: Terminals and airport opening hours
body: Chiang Mai Airport has two passenger-terminal buildings, domestic and international, with a total passenger-terminal area of 31,301 m².
Official service hours are 06:00–24:00. The airport telephone is +66 53 922 000; the Airports of Thailand contact centre is 1722.

sections.title: City shuttles, local buses and Grab
body: After leaving the aircraft, follow the Domestic Arrivals or International Arrivals signs.

Airport shuttles board at Door 12 of the international terminal. A1 passes Nimmanhaemin, Huay Kaew and the old-city moat for 40 baht; A2 passes Mahidol, the Night Bazaar and the Chang Klan hotel area for 40 baht. A3 uses the second ring road towards the 700th Anniversary Stadium for 60 baht.
The listed fare for RTC R3 red/yellow city buses is 30 baht per ride. For an early-morning or late-night journey, first ask whether the service is running.

Order Grab Taxi, Grab Car or Just Grab in the app and board at the designated pickup point. The Grab service centre in the domestic-terminal Level 1 public area operates 24 hours; its telephone is 02-0212530.
Car-rental counters are on Level 1 of the airport.

sections.title: Self-check-in and bag-drop locations and supported airlines
body: The recorded CUSS self-check-in locations in the domestic terminal are: 3 machines in front of the Thai Vietjet counter, 7 in front of the Bangkok Airways office, 8 near Amazon Café and 3 near Wawee Coffee. There are 9 near gates 8–9 in the international terminal.
Recorded CUBD self-service bag-drop machines number 3 in front of the domestic Thai Vietjet counter, 3 near Wawee Coffee and 4 near international gates 8–9.

Self-check-in supports Thai Airways, Thai Lion Air, Bangkok Airways, Thai AirAsia, Thai Vietjet, AirAsia, STARLUX and Cebu Pacific. Self-service bag drop supports Bangkok Airways, AirAsia and Thai AirAsia. Other airlines were listed as being prepared for the service; ask your booked airline whether it is supported before using the machines.

sections.title: Convenience store
body: The Mini Market is in the public arrivals area on Level 1 of the domestic terminal.

faq.q: What are Chiang Mai Airport’s opening hours?
faq.a: The passenger terminal’s official hours are 06:00–24:00. The Grab service centre on domestic-terminal Level 1 operates 24 hours.

faq.q: How can I contact Chiang Mai Airport?
faq.a: Call the airport on +66 53 922 000 or the Airports of Thailand contact centre on 1722.

faq.q: Where do I catch a city shuttle after an international arrival?
faq.a: Board at Door 12 of the international terminal. A1 and A2 cost 40 baht; A3 costs 60 baht. Choose the route that serves your accommodation area.

faq.q: Where do I board Grab at Chiang Mai Airport?
faq.a: Order in the app, then go to the designated pickup point. If you need directions, visit the 24-hour Grab service centre in the public area on domestic-terminal Level 1, telephone 02-0212530.

smoking.title: Outdoor smoking place near Exit 9, Level 1
smoking.access: Follow the on-site Smoking Area signs
smoking.status: Visitor guidance near Exit 9 · confirm on site
body: Recent airport visitor guidance describes a separate outdoor smoking place near Exit 9 on Level 1. Building Exit 9 is different from international boarding Gate 9.

Look for it in the public area before departure immigration. There is no map pin for the smoking-room entrance, so follow Smoking Area signs or ask information staff. It is not directly accessible from the post-immigration area.
